jp.kyasu.awt

クラス Label

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • jp.kyasu.awt.KComponent
        • jp.kyasu.awt.Label
  • すべての実装されたインタフェース:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable
    直系の既知のサブクラス:
    AbstractButton

    public class Label
extends KComponent
    A Label object is a component for placing text in a container. A label displays a single line of read-only text. The text can be changed by the application, but a user cannot edit it directly.

    A Label can also display a visual object in a container.

    For example: 

         setLayout(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.CENTER, 10, 10));
     add(new Label("A Label"));
     add(new Label(
             new Text(
                 "Another Label",
                 new TextStyle("Dialog", Font.BOLD, 12, Color.red))));
     add(new Label(new VImage("image.gif")));
    関連項目:
    Visualizable, VLabel, 直列化された形式
